confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated Numbeo-derived figures (via Expatica), plus Expat Arrivals, HousingAnywhere and Mylifeelsewhere, from mid-2026. I assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15 and did not search for it. No cocktail prices were found, so the cocktail is estimated at about 2.3x the beer price. The wine-by-the-glass price is inferred from bottle prices of about €6 and typical restaurant markups. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Munich prices swing sharply during Oktoberfest and trade fairs. The FX rate is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 Nov 2026 from the RBA overview page. A 19 Nov table value (0.6677) appeared in the search results but was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Munich is Germany's most expensive major city, with prices above Berlin and similar to or slightly above Vienna.
